HEADLINE: Pursuant to Regulation 30 and other applicable provisions of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform you that the Board of Directors ....
MORE:
Pursuant to Regulation 30 and other applicable provisions of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform you that the Board of Directors of Jhandewalas Foods Limited, at its meeting held on Thursday, 12th November, 2026, commenced at 02:30 P.M. and concluded at 06:15 P.M., inter alia, considered and approved the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results of the Company for the half-year ended 30th September, 2026, along with the Limited Review Report issued by the Statutory Auditors, and considered other matters as detailed in the enclosed Outcome of the Board Meeting.

The detailed outcome of the Board Meeting is enclosed herewith for your information and records.

Kindly take the same on record.

HEADLINE: Jhandewalas Foods Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 12/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve Corrigendum to Prior Intimation ....
MORE:
Jhandewalas Foods Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 12/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve Corrigendum to Prior Intimation of Board Meeting dated 04 November 2026

With reference to our earlier intimation dated November 04, 2026, regarding the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company scheduled to be held on Thursday, November 12, 2026, we wish to inform you that due to an inadvertent typographical error, the date of the Board Meeting was incorrectly mentioned as December 12, 2026, in the body of the said intimation.

We hereby clarify that the correct date of the Board Meeting is Thursday, November 12, 2026, as correctly mentioned in the subject line of the original intimation and on the BSE Listing Centre.

All other details and contents of the earlier intimation shall remain unchanged.

HEADLINE: Jhandewalas Foods Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 12/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve The Following agenda matters ....
MORE:
Jhandewalas Foods Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 12/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve The Following agenda matters are to be discussed and approved:

1. To consider and approve the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the half-year ended 30th September, 2026, along with the Limited Review Report.

2.  To take note of the resignation of the Statutory Auditor and consider the appointment of a new Statutory Auditor to fill the casual vacancy, subject to members'' approval.

3. To consider the proposed alteration of the Main Object Clause of the Memorandum of Association, subject to requisite approvals.

4. To finalise the date, time, venue and arrangements for the 20th Annual General Meeting.

5. To review the composition of the Board and its committees.

6. To review statutory and regulatory compliance status and consider corrective actions for pending compliances.
NEWSSUB: Board Meeting Intimation for Intimation Of Board Meeting To Consider Half-Yearly Financial Results And Other Matters
